summary_table.subtitle: CT PPO acute hospital spend is concentrated at Yale with both more admissions and higher paid per admit

rows.scope_note: Short inpatient stays are reclassified to observation, generally limited to 48 hours.
Routine inpatient and outpatient facility services and supplies are bundled, not separately reimbursable.

reimbursement_policies.evidence: Observation services are reimbursed when medically appropriate in contracted acute care hospitals. Observation is generally limited to 48 hours, and short-stay inpatient admissions of 48 hours or less are reclassified to observation unless an exception applies. For DRG admissions, related observation services within three days are included in inpatient payment.

reimbursement_policies.policy_title: Hospital Inclusive Charges Policy, Facility - Reimbursement Policy - UnitedHealthcare Commercial and Individual Exchange
reimbursement_policies.evidence: On-topic as a general facility reimbursement policy, but the requested DRG pattern is not explicitly named. Routine services, supplies, equipment, and nursing components are bundled into room and board, facility, or related service charges for inpatient and outpatient UB04 claims. Ventilator or CPAP management owned by the facility may be reimbursed at one unit per day.

utilization_limits: 1 unit per day for ventilator or CPAP management

recommended_action.description:
Recommendation 1: For California cesarean delivery, do not apply a G0378 observation-stay reclassification on revenue code 0762 even though observation is limited to max 48 hours, because Point32Health expressly exempts obstetrical delivery. Exempt: obstetrical delivery.

Recommendation 2: Bundle routine facility revenue codes 250, 260-269, 270, 279, 300, 309, 361, 391, 410, and 412 when they are billed on the same claim line for the same inpatient or outpatient visit.
